events.title: Proposed ruling: escalate (model confidence 0.55)
events.body:
This is a RydeTAXI trip (F7: base/distance/time meter components, platform fee), so an unexcused off-route segment passes into the fare: the trip's per-km rate is $19.15 ÷ 13.58 km = $1.4102/km, the same rate the fare record states for the excess-distance line [F4][F7][RD-2]. The trace settles the RD-1/RD-4 screen: one off-route segment exists, 22:54–23:03, 3.77 km driven where the optimal route covers 1.64 km, +2.13 km [F3]; no traffic incident on the replaced stretch (F15), and the PIE speed-band-2 record (F12) is only corroboration, not a standalone exemption, so RD-4(a) does not apply [F12][F15][RD-4].

The chat does show consent before the segment started: at 22:51 the driver asked whether he could go round via Guillemard Road and the rider replied "Sure, go ahead" — both timestamped, both before the segment's 22:54 start [F8][F9][F10][RD-5]. But that agreement is a specific named road, not a general route choice, so under RD-5 it covers driving on Guillemard Road only and the record must tie the driven segment to Guillemard Road; nothing in the fact table gives a road name for the driven path. The only record naming a place is the driver's own statement after the trip, which repeats Guillemard Road but is exactly the kind of after-the-fact claim that cannot itself establish consent or the path (G11); the trace states the fact table carries no road names for the driven path [F3][F8][F9][F11][RD-5]. So the scope question is undetermined (G13), not exempt and not counts — and because it changes the amount, it cannot be left open: the case goes to a person [F3][RB? no citation][RD-5].

If the segment is on Guillemard Road, the extra 2.13 km is exempt and nothing is refundable; if it is not tied there, the refund is 2.13 km × $1.4102/km = $3.0037 → $3.00 [F3][F4][RD-2]. RD-6 would then attach flag_account, since the driver's profile shows 2 upheld route disputes in 90 days [F18][RD-6] — but that flag follows only a non-exempt finding, so it is left for the reviewer to set with the refund.

The rider's own requests are both for "no_action", which cannot stand: the record is not clean — a rider-consented deviation whose scope cannot be matched to the driven path is exactly what a human must settle [F3][F8][F9][RD-5]. Safety screen: I read the complaint, both chat messages and the driver's statement, and found no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; rider complaint is about the fare/route only [F8][F9][F11][SAFE-1].
